subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired, should the final exact head accept all privileged third-party action revisions as one grouped security review or split credential-bearing families into narrower PRs?
rationale: Automated checks can prove syntax and pin consistency, but they cannot accept newly pinned third-party code receiving private keys, write access, publishing credentials, agent API keys, and security artifacts.

options.title: Repair and approve grouped update
options.body: Synchronize the assertions, review every exact upstream revision, and approve the stable final head as one dependency batch.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token issuance, Codex execution, CodeQL, and container-publishing action upgrades for narrower owner review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the PR open until Dependabot access and the final exact head are stable enough for coherent security validation.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Synchronize the assertions, review every exact upstream revision, and approve the stable final head as one dependency batch.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest individual coordinator from direct PR engagement and broad workflow routing, with `openclaw/openclaw-secops` needed for security-specific acceptance.
